lines.text: Paul tells Timothy that in the last days terrible times will come.
People in those times will love themselves, money, and pleasure rather than God, and will be boastful and disobedient to their parents.
Paul says these people have a form of godliness but deny its power, so Timothy should debate them.
They worm into households and captivate vulnerable women, and like Jannes and Jambres who opposed Aaron, they oppose the truth.
Paul says these men will not advance much further, and their folly will be plain to everyone.
